EMLW.craft_notes: Crisp restrained badges with differentiated first name, surname and company weights; CJK matches Latin weight well. Correct dimensions, role colors, actual-size six-up Letter layout and crop marks. CSV absent, so exact source spelling and row order cannot be independently checked; exports are internally consistent.
EMLW.revision_notes: Correct Iris / Van der Berg / Lowtide Labs / SPEAKER added at badge 11 and on second print page. Both sponsors use exact #6b3f69 and white text; every non-sponsor PNG remains pixel-identical.

defects.what: Large first names and accented surnames nearly touch vertically, giving these badges tighter rhythm than the rest.

KCBV.craft_notes: Strong practical left-aligned badge layout and clear full-width role bars. Long company fits, empty company leaves clean space. CSV absent, preventing independent spelling/order comparison; supplied PNG/PDF content consistent and print size correct.
KCBV.revision_notes: Eleventh badge and print layout correct. Exact plum sponsor bar with white role lettering, matching sponsor rule recolor, all other PNGs pixel-identical.

defects.what: First and last names are crowded together compared with the surrounding large empty bands.

XVOL.craft_notes: Readable centered badges with all names fitting and proper role colors. PDF uses 1200×900 images at measured 4×3 in, hence 300 dpi; crop marks provided. CSV absent, so source copy and order cannot be verified independently.
XVOL.revision_notes: Added Iris badge correct, sponsors exact plum with white text, print PDF includes 11 badges. Pixel comparison confirms only sponsor bars/text change on original PNGs.

pairwise_round1.why: EMLW's more consistent vertical rhythm and secondary surname weight resolve the long accented names more comfortably.
EMLW separates first name and surname more clearly and uses a better-matched bold Japanese font.
KCBV's shared left edge and role-colored header rule give names and company lines a more organized reading path.
